## `SearchAppSDK`

The global `window.SearchApp` object (SDK v1).

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `readonly version` | `string` | SDK version (semver). |
| `readonly context` | `SearchAppContext` | Storefront context from the app embed. |
| `state` | `{ get(): UrlState; set(next: Partial<UrlState>, options?: { replace?: boolean }): void }` | Reads and writes the search state in the URL. `set()` pushes a history entry unless `replace` is true. |

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `ready(): Promise<SearchAppSDK>` | Resolves once the SDK has loaded. The app embed defines a stub that loads the SDK on demand; it renders at the
end of `<body>`, so call this after `DOMContentLoaded` from section scripts. |
| `search(params?: SearchParams): Promise<SearchResponse>` | Searches products with the merchant's relevance, synonyms, merchandising rules and market prices. |
| `suggest(q: string, options?: { limit?: number }): Promise<SuggestResponse>` | Instant search suggestions: products, collections, pages, articles and query suggestions. |
| `collection(handle: string, params?: CollectionParams): Promise<SearchResponse>` | Filters and sorts products within a collection (by handle). |
| `getConfig(): Promise<PublicConfig>` | Public configuration: filters, sort options, texts and appearance. Cached for the page. |
| `formatMoney(minorUnits: number, currency?: string): string` | Formats minor units with the theme's money format. Defaults to the shopper's currency. |
| `track(type: "click" \| "add_to_cart" \| "filter" \| "sort", data: Record<string, unknown>): void` | Records an anonymous analytics event for search insights. |
| `on(event: SearchAppEvent, handler: (payload: unknown) => void): () => void` | Subscribes to an event. Returns an unsubscribe function. |
| `off(event: SearchAppEvent, handler: (payload: unknown) => void): void` | Removes a handler added with `on()`. |
| `mount(el: HTMLElement \| string, options: MountOptions): Widget \| void` | Mounts a widget into an element or selector. Waits if the widget type isn't registered yet. |
| `registerWidget(type: string, factory: WidgetFactory): void` | Adds a widget type that `mount()` and `data-searchapp-mount` can use. |
| `render(template: string, data: unknown): string` | Renders a template with the SDK's safe template engine (all output is HTML-escaped). |

## `SearchParams`

Parameters for `search()`.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `q?` | `string` | Search terms. Empty returns all products (useful with filters). |
| `filters?` | `Filters` | Selected filters, keyed by filter id from `getConfig().filters`. |
| `sort?` | `string` | Sort key from `sort_options`, for example `price_asc`. Defaults to the shop's default sort. |
| `page?` | `number` | 1-based page number. |
| `perPage?` | `number` | Products per page (max 48). |
| `fields?` | `string[]` | Only return these product fields, for a lighter response. |

## `CollectionParams`

Parameters for `collection()`. `q` narrows results within the collection.

Extends `Omit<SearchParams, "q">`.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `q?` | `string` |  |

## `SearchResponse`

Result of `search()` and `collection()`. Prices are already localized to the shopper's market.

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | `string` |  |
| `redirect` | `string \| null` | Set when the merchant configured a redirect for this query; navigate there instead of rendering. |
| `total` | `number` | Total matching products. |
| `page` | `number` |  |
| `per_page` | `number` |  |
| `pages` | `number` |  |
| `sort` | `string` |  |
| `sort_options` | `SortOption[]` |  |
| `products` | `Product[]` |  |
| `facets` | `Facet[]` | Facets with counts (list facets) or min/max (range facets), in the merchant's configured order. |
| `applied_filters` | `Filters` |  |
| `currency` | `string` | Currency of `price_min` / `price_max` on products. |
| `collection?` | `{ id: string; handle: string }` |  |
| `interpreted?` | `{ query: string; original: string; filters: Filters }` | Set when the merchant turned on query understanding and words in the search became filters: `query` is what
was searched, `filters` were added (prices in `currency`). The SDK writes both to the URL so shoppers can remove them. |

## `FilterValue`

```ts
export type FilterValue = string[] | { min?: number; max?: number } | boolean;
```

## `Filters`

Selected filters keyed by filter id (configured in the app admin). Price ranges use the shopper's currency.

```ts
export type Filters = Record<string, FilterValue>;
```

## `UrlState`

Search state mirrored in the URL using Shopify's native parameters (`q`, `filter.p.*`, `filter.v.*`, `sort_by`, `page`).

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `q?` | `string` |  |
| `filters` | `Filters` |  |
| `sort?` | `string` |  |
| `page?` | `number` |  |
| `original?` | `string` | What the shopper typed, when the app turned words like "red" or "under $50" into filters (`sa_orig`). |
| `literal?` | `boolean` | Search the exact words, without turning them into filters (`sa_literal=1`). |

## `SearchAppEvent`

Events for `on()` / `off()`. Each is also dispatched on `document` as a `CustomEvent` named `searchapp:<event>`
with `:` replaced by `-` (for example `searchapp:filters-change`), with the payload in `detail`.

```ts
export type SearchAppEvent = "ready" | "before-search" | "results" | "render" | "filters:change" | "sort:change" | "error";
```

## `MountOptions`

Options for `mount()`. Extra keys are passed to the widget (for example `perPage`, `collection`).

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `"results" \| "filters" \| "sort" \| "pagination" \| "instant" \| string` | Widget type: built-in `search-page` (alias `results`), `instant`, or a type added with `registerWidget()`. |
| `template?` | `string \| HTMLTemplateElement` | Selector or `<template>` element that overrides the default markup (`data-searchapp="product-card"`, …). |
| `[option: string]` | `unknown` |  |

## `WidgetFactory`

Creates a widget inside `el`. Register it with `registerWidget()`.

```ts
export type WidgetFactory = (el: HTMLElement, options: MountOptions, sdk: SearchAppSDK) => Widget | void;
```
